scheme_name: National Action Plan on Marine Litter (NAPML) Innovation Grant
overview: The National Action Plan on Marine Litter (NAPML) Innovation Grant is a scheme under the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC) aimed at addressing marine litter through innovation and research. It supports projects focused on prevention, reduction, and management of marine litter, particularly plastic waste, in India's coastal and marine environments. The grant encourages technological and behavioral innovations to mitigate marine pollution and aligns with national and international commitments on ocean health.
objectives: Prevent and reduce marine litter, especially plastic waste, entering India's marine and coastal ecosystems
Promote innovative solutions for monitoring, collection, and recycling of marine litter
Strengthen research and development in marine litter management and circular economy approaches
Enhance public awareness and stakeholder engagement on marine litter issues
Support policy implementation and capacity building for effective marine litter governance
eligibility: Eligible applicants include startups, MSMEs, research institutions, NGOs, and other organizations with expertise in environmental science, waste management, or related fields. Applicants must demonstrate technical capability, innovation potential, and alignment with NAPML objectives. Preference is given to entities with prior experience in marine or coastal projects and those proposing scalable, sustainable solutions.
benefits: Financial support for innovative projects, technical guidance from MoEFCC experts, opportunities for pilot testing and scaling, networking with national and international stakeholders, and recognition under national marine litter initiatives. Successful projects may also gain visibility for future funding and policy integration.
financial_support: The scheme provides grant-based financial support to selected projects. The quantum of support is determined based on project scope, innovation level, and implementation plan. Funds are disbursed in tranches linked to project milestones, subject to progress review and utilization certificates.
application_process: 1. Visit the MoEFCC official website or designated portal for scheme details. 2. Review eligibility criteria and guidelines for the NAPML Innovation Grant. 3. Prepare a detailed project proposal including objectives, methodology, budget, and expected outcomes. 4. Submit the application online via the specified portal with all required documents. 5. Applications are screened by a technical committee for eligibility and merit. 6. Shortlisted candidates may be invited for presentation or interview. 7. Final selection is made by the approval committee. 8. Selected applicants receive sanction letters and undergo agreement signing. 9. Funds are released in installments based on project progress. 10. Submit periodic reports and utilization certificates as per guidelines.
required_documents: Previous work experience or project reports
Undertaking of compliance with scheme guidelines
Any other documents as specified in the call for proposal
implementing_agency: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC)
caveats: Projects must align with the National Action Plan on Marine Litter (NAPML) framework
Funding is subject to availability of budget and approval of the competent authority
Grantees must submit utilization certificates and progress reports as per schedule
Intellectual property rights arising from the project may be subject to government norms
The scheme does not cover recurring operational costs or general organizational expenses
